scope: Estimate remaining Stage 1 V6 provider-generation cost without making provider calls or changing the frozen experiment.

notes: Flex is priced at 50% of GPT-6 Sol Standard rates as of 2026-09-30.
Cache-write pricing is not additive: an input token uses the uncached-input, cached-input, or cache-write rate.
Reasoning tokens are included in output tokens and billed at the output-token rate.
No request in this experiment approaches the >272K-input long-context pricing threshold based on observed Stage 1 usage.

projectionForRemaining49.basis: Use exact V5 per-track usage for ordinals 2-50 as a proxy because V6 reuses the same frozen packets; add the observed +268 input/cache-write token prompt delta between V5 and V6 on ordinal 1; hold historical V5 output-token volume constant for the central estimate.
projectionForRemaining49.maxOutputCapScenarioDefinition: All 49 remaining calls consume the projected input cost plus the full frozen 8192 output-token cap, with no retries.
limitations: Output/reasoning-token use varies by track and may differ under V6.
The V6 canary is only one direct V5-to-V6 token comparison.
This is a planning estimate, not an authorization to spend or a billing guarantee.

userReportedBalanceContext.interpretation: The reported balance is unlikely to cover all 49 remaining V6 development calls. Partial spending would not unlock protocol-valid Stage 1 scoring because all 50 V6 responses must be frozen before references are opened.

currentRecommendation.reason: Preserve the existing balance while zero-cost preparation and documentation remain possible. When full V6 generation is ready for explicit authorization, fund enough to complete the remaining set rather than starting a partial run that cannot yet be scored.
